facts.text: John attended a convention with his colleagues last month where they discussed using technology for good in their community.

evidence.quote: My colleagues and I went to a convention together last month. We're all passionate about using tech for good in our community.
Talking with the group of people who were as stoked as me on tech for change was awesome!

facts.text: John described the convention as an environment with infectious energy where people had great ideas and stayed motivated.

evidence.quote: The best part was the energy in the room - so infectious! We all had great ideas, brainstormed together, and stayed motivated.
Talking with the group of people who were as stoked as me on tech for change was awesome!

facts.text: John felt that being surrounded by motivated people at the convention gave him renewed energy and a sense of purpose.

evidence.quote: The motivated people around me gave me renewed energy and a purpose.
We all had great ideas, brainstormed together, and stayed motivated.
